h1: AI Product Video Generator: Link, Avatar and Script
lead: A single catalog photo can still become a spoken product video for the listing. You are not booking a crew.

benefits.d: You do not need an editing past. A short setup is enough to get a full product video out.
Change the sentence, the AI actor, or the counter shot on a granola pouch without rebuilding the whole clip. Drop a word the shop never uses.

benefits.t: A Voice That Sounds Like a Person
benefits.d: A steadier voice lets a lipstick demo sound like advice from someone who wears it. A shouty promo voice fights a simple product.

Starter is $24.50 a month for 200 credits, Pro is $35 for 300, and Premium is $63 for 600. A 6-second video is 24 credits, 10 seconds is 40, 15 is 60, and 30 is 120. You see that cost before it runs. Creator day rates stay off the invoice, and that money can go into the ad budget.
If none of the stock faces match the running-shoe brand, build a custom actor and keep that face on the shoe videos.

steps.t: Add a Link or a Photo
steps.d: Paste the insulated bottle page. The photo and title claim become the clip. A private page can use one photo instead.
Choose the actor in a jacket by a sink for the bottle ad. The hand and the bottle then read at phone size.
If the bottle draft says gym essential and you would not, replace it. The actor speaks the line you leave in.

faq.q: How does a shop get a video of a product it already lists?
faq.a: Paste the listing you already have. The photo on that page becomes the clip, and you download it with no watermark after you approve the line.

faq.q: What settings can I choose before making a product video?
faq.a: Set the length and the frame, then approve the spoken line. You can still change that line after the draft appears.

faq.q: What length should a product video use?
faq.a: Match the length to the action. A short demo can be 6 seconds for 24 credits, a tighter cut 10 seconds for 40, a standard cut 15 seconds for 60, or a longer cut 30 seconds for 120.

faq.q: Can a product demo be made here without filming?
faq.a: Yes. The actor can show the product in use while saying the one benefit you kept. You are not renting a set for the shoot.

faq.q: What happens after I paste a public product page?
faq.a: The page supplies the product photo and the claim you already wrote. Those two pieces are what the spoken clip is built around, with an AI actor holding the item.

faq.q: Can I change the video after it is drafted?
faq.a: Yes. Rewrite a sentence, choose a different AI actor, or change the setting. Add your logo when the words are right. The same line can be spoken in another language you sell in.

faq.q: How is this different from filming the product?
faq.a: Filming means reserving a set and a person who can demo the item. Here you start from the product photo. If the render fails, the credits come back.

faq.q: How do I keep the video in my brand's voice?
faq.a: Read the line out loud and rewrite it if it does not sound like the shop. Your logo and colors can sit on the last frame, and store software can request the same job through an API.

definition.title: What Is an AI Product Video?
paras: This tool turns a product page or one photo into a short video shoppers can judge. An AI actor can hold the item or use it on camera while a script explains why to buy it.
You approve the line before the clip goes to TikTok, Reels, or the product page. Frames include square 1:1, wide 16:9, and tall 9:16, plus 4:3 and 3:4.

reasons.h2: Make a Product Video Shoppers Can Judge
reasons.lead: A still photo still leaves size, use, and the reason to buy up to the imagination. A product video can carry all three.

items.t: Show the Size in a Hand
items.d: A buyer can judge a French press against a palm when an actor holds it on the counter, instead of guessing from a white-field silhouette.
A buyer sees how a serum dispenses when the actor presses the pump once. A still photo never shows that move.

items.t: A Line That Makes the Case
items.d: The wireless earbuds get the commute line you already say, once you approve the wording. A still photo can't say it for you.

benefits_lead: The point is not one pretty clip. It is enough versions to learn which hook deserves the budget.
